label: TP
reason: User-supplied header name flows through doSomething into bar, then into a file URI constructed via concatenation ('file:' + prefix + bar). The resulting File object's toString() is printed directly to HTML without neutralizing script characters. Although ESAPI.encodeForHTML is called, it encodes the entire file path string rather than just the injected portion, so XSS payloads like '<script>' remain intact in the rendered page.

evidence.note: User input from HTTP headers assigned to param
Param passed to doSomething and returned as bar
File URI built with unencoded bar and printed to response
